description: Donald Trump announced phased tariffs on imported generic medicines starting August 2026.  These tariffs will gradually increase to 200 percent over three years.  This policy aims to reshore pharmaceutical production back into America.  India, a major supplier of affordable generics, faces significant impact from these changes.  The move adds uncertainty to ongoing bilateral trade agreement.
title: 0%, 100%, then 200%: How Trump's new generic drug tariff plan could hit India

description: President Donald Trump approved a nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia.  This accord could allow uranium enrichment capabilities for their civilian nuclear program. description: The recurring injuries suffered by Harshit Rana and Nitish Kumar Reddy have not gone down well with the BCCI. description: Brad Paisley, who attended Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's July 3 wedding at Madison Square Garden with wife Kimberly Williams-Paisley, has described the event as "one of the least pretentious weddings" he has ever attended. description: Ben Stokes scored an unbeaten 108 for Durham in his first match after retiring from international cricket. He guided his team to a five-wicket victory over Derbyshire in the One-Day Cup. Stokes battled cramp throughout his match-winning innings, staying until the end. Earlier, Derbyshire posted 256/9, with Martin Andersson scoring 112 runs. Stokes recently announced his retirement from all international formats of the game.

author: VAIBHAV GANJAPURE
description: The Bombay High Court enhanced a wife's monthly maintenance payment. An educated wife cannot be denied support simply for possessing qualifications. The court found no proof the wife quit her job to claim maintenance. The husband's claims of her employment were unsubstantiated by evidence. The court considered the husband's income and the child's expenses.
title: Bombay HC grants Rs 20,000 maintenance to educated, unemployed wife

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Warren Buffett has confirmed that the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation will no longer receive any future donations from him, ending a philanthropic partnership that lasted more than two decades. The 95-year-old Berkshire Hathaway chairman said the decision was part of a broader review of his estate plans and not a reflection of his personal friendship with Bill Gates. Buffett said Gates was aware of the decision and that the two remain close friends despite recent public scrutiny surrounding Gates.
title: Buffett: Gates knew foundation funds would stop, admits Epstein error, trusts kids with fortune

author: SAEED KHAN
description: A Vadodara woman seeks to revert to her Christian maiden name after facing housing challenges. She adopted a Muslim name after marrying a Muslim man, which now causes social issues. The Gujarat High Court has issued notices to state authorities regarding her name change request. Authorities previously denied her gazette publication without a divorce decree. The court is now seeking replies on why her request was not accepted.
title: ‘Muslim name hurting house hunt’: Woman moves HC for ‘ghar waapsi’

author: SHAFAQUE ALAM
description: New constructions are appearing on the Hindon river floodplain, three years after devastating floods. Residents have rebuilt homes and added structures, citing past government inaction. Land sharks are allegedly dumping debris and narrowing the river's course for plot sales. Environmental activists note ongoing construction activity despite official oversight. Authorities have conducted anti-encroachment drives, clearing some floodplain areas.
title: In 2023, Hindon entered villages. In 2026, villages have gone further into Hindon

Airlines may be cautious due to ongoing regional conflicts and security concerns.
title: US airlines to resume direct flights to Lebanon after 40 years, says Donald Trump
